title: How to exclude empty array with to_json
question:
Is there any way to exclude null arrays/structs when using to_json? I'm getting something like this coming back: {"arrayColumn":[{}]}

Here's a really crude example:

    from pyspark.sql.functions import to_json, struct,array,lit

    somedata = """
    col1
    foo
    bar
    baz
    """
    lines = somedata.strip().split('\n')
    header = lines[0].split(',')
    rows = [line.split(',') for line in lines[1:]]
    
    df = spark.createDataFrame(rows, header)
    df2 = df.withColumn("type",struct(array(struct(lit(None).alias("a"),lit(None).alias("b"))).alias("arrayColumn")))
    
    df2.withColumn("msg",struct("col1","type")).select(to_json("msg")).show(truncate = False)

I am looking to get this back: {"col1":"foo"} But instead I'm getting back: {"col1":"foo","type":{"arrayColumn":[{}]}}
answer:
I know your example is meant to be general, so I am not sure how dynamic to make my solution, but you could try something like checking that the inner most elements of the type column are all null. I also expanded the coverage of your dummy data to also include some values in the type column that are non-null.

Also the return type of msg needs to be consistent, so you can't conditionally return struct(col1) or struct(col1, col2) because these are considered different types. Instead you can return something like struct(col1, None) or struct(col1, col2).

from pyspark.sql.functions import to_json, struct,array,lit,array_except

somedata = """
col1
foo
bar
baz
"""
lines = somedata.strip().split('\n')
header = lines[0].split(',')
rows = [line.split(',') for line in lines[1:]]

df = spark.createDataFrame(rows, header)
df2 = df.withColumn("type",struct(array(struct(lit(None).alias("a"),lit(None).alias("b"))).alias("arrayColumn")))
df3 = df.withColumn("type",struct(array(struct(lit('int').alias("a"),lit('int').alias("b"))).alias("arrayColumn")))
df4 = df2.union(df3)

df4.withColumns({
    "type_null": when(
        (size(array_except(col("type.arrayColumn.a"), array(lit(None)))) == 0) 
        & (size(array_except(col("type.arrayColumn.b"), array(lit(None)))) == 0),
        True
    ),
    "msg": when(
        col("type_null"),
        struct(col("col1"), lit(None).alias("type"))  # {"col1": "foo"}
    ).otherwise(
        struct(col("col1"), col("type"))  # {"col1": "foo", "type": {...}}
    )
})

Result:

+----+----------------+---------+---------------------+
|col1|type            |type_null|msg                  |
+----+----------------+---------+---------------------+
|foo |{[{NULL, NULL}]}|true     |{foo, NULL}          |
|bar |{[{NULL, NULL}]}|true     |{bar, NULL}          |
|baz |{[{NULL, NULL}]}|true     |{baz, NULL}          |
|foo |{[{int, int}]}  |NULL     |{foo, {[{int, int}]}}|
|bar |{[{int, int}]}  |NULL     |{bar, {[{int, int}]}}|
|baz |{[{int, int}]}  |NULL     |{baz, {[{int, int}]}}|
+----+----------------+---------+---------------------+
